r: A steak seared to your liking with crispy homemade chips.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse them and dry them well.
Fry them for 6 min at 160 °C, then drain.|Frying|6
Cook the steaks in the butter for 2 to 3 min on each side, depending on how you like them.|Pan|5
Fry the chips again for 3 min at 180 °C, add salt and serve.|Frying|3
A creamy pepper sauce coats the steak.
The bistro classic, with its creamy pepper sauce.
Coat the steaks in the crushed peppercorns.
Cook them in the butter for 2 to 3 min on each side. Keep warm.|Pan|5
Fry the shallot, pour in the cognac, then the cream, and let it reduce for 3 min.|Sauce|3
Add salt and pour over the steaks.
The chips are baked in the oven with a drizzle of oil.
Steak and chips without a deep fryer.
Cut the potatoes into chips, toss them with the oil, paprika and salt, and spread them on a tray.
Bake for 35 min, turning halfway through.|Oven|35
Cook the steaks in a pan for 2 to 3 min on each side.|Pan|5
Strips of beef seared in a wok with onions and soy sauce.
Cut the beef into thin strips and mix with the cornflour and 1 tbsp of soy sauce.
Sear it for 2 min over a very high heat in the oil. Set aside.|Wok|2
Stir-fry the sliced onions and garlic for 4 min.|Wok|4
Put the beef back in with the rest of the soy sauce and the sugar for 1 min. Serve with rice.|Wok|1
Broccoli replaces some of the onions.
The takeaway beef stir-fry, with crunchy broccoli.
Blanch the broccoli florets for 2 min.|Cooking|2
Sear the beef strips for 2 min. Set aside.|Wok|2
Stir-fry the garlic, ginger and broccoli for 3 min.|Wok|3
Put the beef back in with the soy sauce mixed with the cornflour and 5 cl of water, for 1 min.|Wok|1
Colourful peppers and an oyster sauce.
A colourful stir-fry of peppers and beef.
Sear the beef strips for 2 min. Set aside.|Wok|2
Stir-fry the peppers and onion for 4 min.|Wok|4
Put the beef back in with the sauces for 1 min.|Wok|1
Tender pork medallions in a creamy mustard sauce.
Cut the tenderloin into thick medallions and brown them in the butter for 3 min on each side.|Pan|6
Add the shallots, then the wine, and let it reduce for 2 min.|Cooking|2
Add the cream and mustard, cover and cook for 8 min.|Cooking|8
Roasted whole in the oven and glazed with honey.
A juicy, fragrant honey-glazed pork tenderloin.
Brown the whole tenderloins in the oil on all sides.
Brush them with honey, add the garlic and rosemary, and season with salt and pepper.
Roast for 20 min, then rest for 5 min before slicing.|Oven|20
A mushroom sauce replaces the mustard.
Pork tenderloin in a creamy mushroom sauce.
Brown the medallions in the butter for 3 min on each side. Set aside.|Pan|6
Fry the shallot and mushrooms for 6 min.|Pan|6
Add the cream and the meat, and simmer for 6 min.|Simmer|6
The Easter roast: pink in the middle, studded with garlic and flavoured with rosemary.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Take the lamb out of the fridge 1 h beforehand.
Stud it with garlic cloves and rub with oil, salt, pepper and rosemary.
Place it on the chopped potatoes and bake for 1 h 10 for pink lamb.|Oven|70
Rest for 10 min under foil before carving.|Rest|10
A shoulder cooked slowly for 4 h, so the meat falls apart.
Melt-in-the-mouth lamb that you can eat with a spoon.
Brown the shoulder in a casserole dish with the oil.
Add the onions, the unpeeled garlic, the thyme, the wine, salt and pepper.
Cover and bake for 4 h, basting from time to time.|Oven|240
Lamb simmered with small spring vegetables.
The lamb stew with carrots, turnips and peas.
Brown the lamb in the oil with the onions, and sprinkle with flour.
Add the tomatoes, the bouquet garni and enough water to cover. Simmer for 1 h.|Simmer|60
Add the carrots, turnips and potatoes, and cook for 30 min.|Cooking|30
Add the peas 10 min before the end.|Cooking|10
Beef simmered in dark beer with gingerbread and soft brown sugar.
Brown the cubed beef in the butter. Set aside.
Soften the sliced onions for 10 min.|Cooking|10
Put the meat back in, pour in the beer, and add the thyme, sugar, salt and pepper.
Spread the gingerbread with mustard and lay it on top.
Simmer, covered, for 2 h 30. Serve with chips.|Simmer|150
In a pressure cooker: 1 h instead of 3.
Brown the beef and onions in the pressure cooker.
Add the beer, the gingerbread spread with mustard, salt and pepper.
Close it and cook for 45 min after it starts to hiss.|Pressure cooker|45
Brown the chicken and onions in the butter.
Add the beer, the gingerbread spread with mustard, salt and pepper.
A turkey escalope stuffed with ham and cheese, breaded and golden.
Flatten the escalopes and slice them in half through the thickness without cutting all the way.
Fill with ham and emmental, then close.
Dip them in the flour, the beaten egg and then the breadcrumbs.
Brown them in the oil for 5 min on each side.|Pan|10
Baked in the oven, with no frying.
Lighter cordon bleus, baked in the oven.
Fill and close the escalopes, then dip them in the egg and breadcrumbs.
Put them on a tray, drizzle with oil and bake for 25 min.|Oven|25
Chicken replaces the turkey, with mozzarella.
A chicken cordon bleu, with melting mozzarella.
Cut a pocket in each chicken breast and fill with ham and mozzarella.
Brown them for 6 min on each side over a medium heat.|Pan|12
A breaded, golden veal escalope, served with lemon and tomato spaghetti.
Dip the escalopes in the flour, the beaten egg and then the breadcrumbs.
Brown them in the butter for 3 min on each side and serve with lemon.|Pan|6
The breaded chicken escalope, crunchy and good value.
Slice the breasts in half through the thickness and flatten them.
Brown them for 4 min on each side.|Pan|8
A pan-fried escalope coated in a creamy mushroom sauce.
The Normandy-style escalope, with cream and mushrooms.
Lightly flour the escalopes and brown them in the butter for 2 min on each side. Set aside.|Pan|4
Add the cream, salt and pepper, put the escalopes back and simmer for 3 min.|Simmer|3
Salted pork and sausages simmered with green lentils and carrots.

Put it in a casserole dish with the onion studded with the cloves and the bouquet garni, cover with water and cook for 45 min.|Cooking|45
Add the lentils, the sliced carrots and the pricked sausage, and cook for 30 min.|Cooking|30
Season with pepper and serve piping hot.
Just sausages, so it is quicker.
Fry the bacon lardons and onion in a casserole dish.
Add the lentils, carrots, stock cube, thyme and 80 cl of water.
Add the sausages and cook for 30 min.|Cooking|30
No meat, with more vegetables and smoked paprika.
Soft lentils with vegetables, smoked with paprika.
Fry the onion, leek and carrots in the oil for 5 min.|Cooking|5
Add the lentils, tomatoes, paprika and 80 cl of water.
Simmer for 30 min and add salt at the end.|Simmer|30
Spice-marinated chicken, grilled and stuffed into a pitta with salad and white sauce.

Grill the chicken in the oil for 10 min, then cut it into thin strips.|Pan|10
Mix the other yogurt with a little garlic and salt for the white sauce.
Fill the warm pittas with chicken, lettuce, tomato, onion and sauce.
Pork marinated in oregano, with tzatziki.
The Greek sandwich, with pork and tzatziki.
Cut the pork into thin strips and mix with the oil, oregano, paprika and salt.
Grill it for 8 min over a high heat.|Pan|8
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it dry and mix with the yogurt and garlic.
Fill the pittas with meat, tomato, onion and tzatziki.
The veggie kebab, with falafels and hummus.

Mix the yogurt with the lemon juice.
Spread the pittas with hummus and fill with vegetables, falafels and sauce.
Crispy breaded chicken pieces, far better than shop-bought ones.
Crush the cornflakes and mix them with the breadcrumbs and paprika.
Dip the chicken in the salted flour, the beaten egg and then the crumb mix.

Baked in the oven with a drizzle of oil.

The coating is spiced up with chilli and garlic.
Crunchy, spicy chicken strips, fast-food style.
